name: Smoked Pork with Bamboo Shoot
instructions: 1. Cut the smoked pork into bite-sized pieces and wash thoroughly.
2. In a heavy-bottomed pot, add the pork, chopped ginger, crushed garlic, and salt with enough water to cover.
3. Simmer over low heat until the meat is tender and the smoky flavor is infused into the broth.
4. Add the fermented bamboo shoot and the slit Bhut Jolokia chili.
5. Continue cooking for another 15-20 minutes until the flavors meld together into a thick, aromatic stew.
6. Serve hot with steamed red rice.
description: Smoked Pork with Bamboo Shoot is a quintessential Naga dish reflecting the community's preservation techniques. The fermentation of bamboo provides a distinctive acidic tang that balances the rich, intense smokiness of the pork, serving as a comfort food staple in Naga households.
